questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 9 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 9 × 10 = 45 cm². Slow down and halve after multiplying, not before — the rush mistake is skipping the ½ step.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A cylinder has height 10 cm and radius 2 cm. Which measurement do you multiply by 2πr to get curved surface area?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Curved surface area = 2πr × height, since 2πr is the circumference and the curved face unrolls into a rectangle that long and that tall.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: What building did Hitler's 1923 putsch march begin from?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: The putsch began at the Bürgerbräukeller, a Munich beer hall, where Hitler interrupted a meeting to declare his revolution — hence its name, the Beer Hall Putsch.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 22 cm and a height of 8 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 22 × 8 = 88 cm². Say the formula before multiplying so the halving step doesn't get rushed past.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: From a while back — in Lord of the Flies, what does the fire on the mountain mainly represent?
questions.why: The signal fire represents the boys' hope of being rescued and returning to civilisation — letting it go out shows that hope fading.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a word equation for a chemical reaction, what do we call the new substances formed?
questions.why: The new substances formed in a chemical reaction are called products; they are made from the reactants combining or changing.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What word describes a chemical reaction that gives off heat and feels warm?
questions.why: An exothermic reaction releases heat energy to its surroundings, which is why it feels warm as it happens.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: What is it called when a company pays a celebrity to use their product in ads?
questions.why: Celebrity endorsement means a famous person is paid to be shown using a product, making it seem more appealing even if it isn't actually healthy.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, what does the fat content mainly tell you about a food?
questions.why: Fat provides more energy per gram than protein or carbohydrate, so the fat content on a label is a key clue to how energy-dense a food is.
